mats.name: Novella Leatherette
mats.why: Green vines, copper flowers and a plum butterfly: three of her face colours on one mat, framed in a warm red that sits next to the Timber backs.

mats.name: Dark Teal Cocktail Hour
mats.why: A deep teal field like her dots and North crane, with a copper line that picks up the koi. Teal against wood is the classic contrast for this set.

mats.name: Crane & Moon
mats.why: A rare one from the motif search: white cranes on deep teal-green with coral and copper blooms. Her crane winds, her deep teal, her copper, all at once.

mats.name: Crane Lantern Pattern
mats.why: Cranes over a deep green and teal tapestry with rust-red and gold: the origami cranes, the green bams and the copper koi in one mat (Luna EK Studio, the maker of your Smith Terracotta pick).
mats.photo_note: Nov 16: full-size brand photo (Etsy il_fullxfull cropped to the mat)

mats.name: Vegan Leather – Caramel
mats.why: Bam Bird shoots Origami Timber on this caramel leather themselves (listing photo 12). Warm on warm, so her teal and green faces do the talking.

mats.name: Harvest Leaves
mats.why: Deep forest green with rust and copper leaves: her green bams and copper koi, and the leaves echo the wood backs.
